# OpenViktor

> Open-source AI employee for Slack. Hire an AI teammate that gets its own identity, learns from every conversation, understands your organization, and takes initiative.

## What is OpenViktor?

OpenViktor is an open-source AI employee platform. It creates AI teammates that live inside your Slack workspace with their own identity — their own email, Slack handle, and presence in the team directory. Unlike chatbots, OpenViktor employees learn from every interaction, understand organizational context, and proactively take action.

## Key Capabilities

- Runs inside Slack with its own handle and identity
- Learns from every teammate and conversation
- Sends real emails from its own inbox
- Opens tickets, pulls data, builds reports
- Catches problems before you do
- Handles follow-ups without reminders
- 24/7 availability, no time zones, no holidays
- 2-minute setup, no IT ticket required
- Works with your existing stack (GitHub, Linear, Google Workspace, etc.)

## How It Works

1. **Open a position** — Define the role you want to hire for
2. **AI employee joins Slack** — Gets its own identity and access
3. **Learns your organization** — Understands context from conversations and docs
4. **Takes initiative** — Proactively handles tasks, follow-ups, and reporting

## Use Cases

- Operations automation
- Customer support triage
- Internal knowledge management
- Meeting follow-ups and action items
- Report generation
- Ticket management
- Cross-team coordination

## Technical Details

- Open-source: https://github.com/zggf-zggf/openviktor/
- Stack: TypeScript, Bun, PostgreSQL, Redis, Prisma ORM
- Slack integration via Socket Mode (no public URL needed)
- Self-hostable with Docker
- Provider-agnostic LLM support

## Pricing

- **Free tier** available (open-source, self-host)
- **Managed hosting** available at openviktor.com
